## s19-v02 — argument map

From the One container, all is got through the self, from You (sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam). Yet this own self of mine joins Thee not (asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase).

### Open
- nijā (fem.) + tām (her) figure the self as feminine before the Lord; paramās segmentation is open (supreme ones? be supreme?); L2's 'Her' is conjectural — needs Kṣemarāja Vivṛti.
